# Likerts

Likerts is a social mind-reading and quiz game. Play Live in a browser, or create and practice a quiz locally. The iPhone and native Messages game is coming soon.

- [Game home](https://likerts.com/)
- [Play Live](https://likerts.com/play)
- [Create or practice quizzes](https://likerts.com/play/quizzes)
- [Support](https://likerts.com/game/support)
- [Privacy policy](https://likerts.com/game/privacy)
